Read-only review: no build, no runner, no local gate. Head sha: 859dce67c45acdcd97acf91efa471c541bbc6a5e (branch release/v0.27.0, base main).

What was checked:
- Check 1 - version: PASS. Cargo.toml has workspace version 0.27.0. RELEASE_NOTES.md has "CamCraft 0.27.0" and "Released 2026-11-26". Cargo.lock has the 12 crates at 0.27.0; the diff is a version bump.
- Check 2 - breaking changes first: PASS. "## Breaking" is the first section after the release header. It lists v78 -> v82 (v79 taper tip form, v80 2D Chamfer tip offset, v81 stated rotary axis, v82 Rotary Flow), the .camtools 5/6 change (was 4), and the one-time regeneration of operations with start or exit picks (#3339, PR #3871).
- Check 3 - known issues: PASS. RELEASE_NOTES.md "All open P1 and P2 issues" lists 37 issues. This matches the open P1 (11) and P2 (26) issue lists exactly. The two important P1 issues (#4031 and #4004) are named with attention notes. #4004's fix, PR #4009, was removed from the cut and is noted. The PR comment lists the same set.
- Check 4 - changelog rows: PASS. Rows exist for #3980, #3997, #3970, #4002 and #4033. Each row text matches or closely matches the PR's "Changelog:" line. #4064 (merged; Changelog: none) and #3990 and #4074 (open PRs, not merged) have no row, which is correct.
- Check 5 - process changes: PASS. RELEASE_NOTES.md has a "Process changes" section: "PROCESS_VERSION went from 145 to 155", listing 146, 147, 148, 149/150/152, 151, 153, 154 and 155. This matches the previous tag v0.26.0 (145) and the #681 comments.
- Check 6 - private testdata: PASS. The changed files are CHANGELOG.md, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, RECOMMENDED.md, RELEASE_NOTES.md and 126 deleted docs/decisions/*.md files. No private model, project file, machine file or recording is added or changed.

Verdict: no blockers.
